mightSay: Actually what happened is, the server was down, so because of that we could not do the release yesterday.
better: Yesterday's release slipped because the server went down.

next.title: Even better

lines.label: Add the next step
lines.text: Yesterday's release slipped because the server went down. We'll ship it today by 4.

next.note: Answer their next question before they ask it.

mightSay: I am thinking that maybe we should go with second option only, because first one is having more cost.
better: I'd go with option two. Option one costs more for the same result.

next.title: Show the trade-off

lines.label: Trade-off
lines.text: Option two is cheaper, but it takes a week longer.

next.note: Name what matters most.

mightSay: Maybe Friday would be good, I am not sure.
better: I'd aim for Friday. That gives us two days to test.

next.title: Name the risk

lines.label: Risk
lines.text: Thursday is possible, but we'd have no time to test.

next.note: Show what the extra time buys.

mightSay: Before I said yes but now I think no.
better: I've changed my mind. The new price is beyond our budget.

next.title: Suggest another path

lines.label: Alternative
lines.text: Could we start with the smaller plan?

next.note: Name the new information.

mightSay: Both plans are good and bad in different ways.
better: Plan A costs less. Plan B saves time. I'd choose B for this deadline.

next.title: Set a condition

lines.label: Condition
lines.text: If the deadline moves, I'd reconsider plan A.

next.note: Say what could change your view.

mightSay: It will take two days I think maybe.
better: I estimate two days, assuming the data is ready.

next.title: Handle uncertainty

lines.label: If needed
lines.text: If the data needs cleaning, allow another day.

next.note: Keep estimates separate from promises.

mightSay: This one is important so we should do it first.
better: Let's fix login first. People can't use the app without it.

next.title: Explain the order

lines.label: Next
lines.text: Then we can improve search, which still works.

next.note: Use the effect on people as your reason.

mightSay: Please revert by Friday.
better: Please reply by Friday.

next.title: Make the reply specific

lines.label: Request
lines.text: Please confirm the delivery date by Friday.

next.note: Use reply when you want an answer.

mightSay: Please do the needful.
better: Please approve the invoice by noon.

next.title: Add useful context

lines.label: Context
lines.text: The supplier needs approval before sending the order.

next.note: A clear request is easier to act on.

mightSay: Can we prepone the meeting?
better: Can we move the meeting to 10 a.m.?

next.title: Keep the choice open

lines.label: Question
lines.text: Would 10 a.m. work for everyone?

next.note: For an international audience, spell out the change.

mightSay: I have one doubt in this report.
better: I have a question about this report.

next.title: Ask the question

lines.label: Specific
lines.text: Does this total include tax?

next.note: Put the actual question next.

mightSay: Myself Rohan, from finance.
better: I'm Rohan from finance.

next.title: Add your role

lines.label: Role
lines.text: I handle supplier payments.

next.note: Give one detail they can use.

mightSay: I am having a spare charger.
better: I have a spare charger.

next.title: Make an offer

lines.label: Offer
lines.text: You can borrow it if you like.

next.note: Add the useful next sentence.

mightSay: I know her since college.
better: I've known her since college.

next.title: Add a detail

lines.label: Detail
lines.text: We were in the same class.

next.note: Keep the context simple.

mightSay: I have sent it yesterday.
better: I sent it yesterday.

next.title: Help them find it

lines.label: Location
lines.text: It's in the project chat.

next.note: Add where to look.

mightSay: The work is going on and all.
better: The draft is done. I'm checking the figures now.

next.title: Give a finish time

lines.label: Timing
lines.text: I'll send it by three.

next.note: Use a time you can meet.

mightSay: Please help me in this thing.
better: Could you check this formula?

next.title: Explain the problem

lines.label: Problem
lines.text: The total looks too high.

next.note: Show where you are stuck.

mightSay: You are wrong about this number.
better: I get a different total. Can we check it together?

next.title: Point to evidence

lines.label: Evidence
lines.text: My sheet includes the delivery charge.

next.note: Compare the details calmly.

mightSay: Why have you not replied till now?
better: Have you had a chance to review the draft?

next.title: Explain the timing

lines.label: Timing
lines.text: I need your comments before the meeting tomorrow.

next.note: Give context without blame.

mightSay: I cannot do this, too much work.
better: I can take this on Monday. Today I need to finish payroll.

next.title: Offer a choice

lines.label: Choice
lines.text: Should I pause payroll to do this first?

next.note: Let the owner choose the priority.
